description: Healthy site that publishes a correct sitemap index (sitemap.xml -> sitemap-pages.xml) with lastmod dates, declared through a Sitemap: directive in robots.txt. Everything a crawler needs is already in place.

expected_non_findings.reason: robots.txt allows every crawler and declares a sitemap
All content is server-rendered in the raw HTML
Harborline Logistics is named consistently throughout
Navigation and footer link every key page
Every fact is stated in text

expected_proactive: Add Product or Service structured data for the individual service lines
Add FAQ structured data for common importer questions
forbidden_proactive: Publish an XML sitemap with lastmod dates
notes: Regression guard for the sitemap false positive. This site publishes a sitemap index with lastmod dates; an agent that recommends publishing a sitemap here is reporting on a body it discarded rather than on the site. An agent that reports zero sitemap URLs has not followed the <sitemapindex> into its children.
